headline: AI-Native SDLC Pioneers Transform Fortune 2000 Companies
summary: Tenex, in collaboration with industry experts, has developed an AI-native Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) approach, which is being adopted by Fortune 2000 companies. This shift is driving a new era of AI integration in software development, enhancing efficiency and innovation.
whyItMatters: It accelerates the adoption of AI in enterprise software development, potentially reshaping how large corporations approach technology and innovation.
